args.title: Fix deduplication for overlapping statement transactions
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Modify the deduplication logic in dedupe.ts to correctly handle overlapping days when two statements are uploaded together. Currently, the dedupe function uses a key based on date, amount, and description, which misses overlapping transactions across uploads done close in time. The fix should improve the detection of duplicates across these uploads.

file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is due to how dedupe.ts generates keys for transactions using only date, amount, and description. This misses cases where overlapping days are included in sequential uploads done very close in time, leading to missed duplicates. The dedupe.ts file is responsible for the deduplication logic and should be modified to better handle these overlapping statements.
